probability: p_eligible = sigmoid(platt_a * (logit1 - logit0) + platt_b); Platt fitted on validation only
threshold_policy: Decision threshold chosen on the VALIDATION split only: maximise balanced accuracy (mean of recall on both classes) over a 0.01 grid in [0.05, 0.95]; ties -> closest to 0.5. A lender with explicit error costs should replace this criterion.
note: 'hard' is a comparator trained without the Teacher; 'kd' is the distilled Student to deploy.
